description:
Open the 'Measure Angle' activity in GCompris (located in Math > Geometry). The activity displays an angle and provides a virtual protractor. Your goal is to correctly measure and answer 2 consecutive angle problems.

For each problem:
1. Drag the protractor so its center aligns with the vertex of the angle.
2. Rotate the protractor to align the baseline with one side of the angle.
3. Read the measurement from the scale where the other side crosses.
4. Type the value and submit.

After successfully answering the second problem (look for the success animation/flower), take a screenshot of the success state and save it to '/home/ga/Documents/protractor_success.png'.
